mentions.name: Focusflows.eu
mentions.description: This tool helps people improve their focus while working or studying, with features designed to make staying focused easier without feeling overwhelmed. It is part of an exploration of productivity and digital well-being ideas.
mentions.problem: Staying focused while working or studying is difficult, and focus support can feel overwhelming.
mentions.audience: People who want to improve focus while working or studying, i.e. workers and students.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on Focusflows.eu, a tool I'm building to help people improve their focus while working or studying.
